assessment.mode: Provisional streaming candidate; data and novelty unresolved

gate_evidence.G1: Studies in section 3 show that short input and telephone processing affect detection and confidence.
gate_evidence.G2: The question concerns a learned detector and when it has enough evidence to decide.
gate_evidence.G3: All three contributions train or adapt models rather than only call an API.
gate_evidence.G4: No suitable reusable Sinhala real/fake dataset with speaker and generator records has been secured.
gate_evidence.G5: The bounded study uses existing labels. New callers, recordings and expert labelling are excluded.
gate_evidence.G6: Streaming, short-input and limited-language detection already exist; the extra contribution needs checking.
gate_evidence.G7: Training and comparison experiments are central; the app only demonstrates the result.
gate_evidence.G8: Metrics are defined, but suitable Sinhala data, source groups and clip lengths are not verified.
gate_evidence.G9: Data access and baseline reproduction must be resolved before the schedule is credible.
gate_evidence.G10: Section 6 gives separate questions, methods, comparisons and results for one shared problem.
gate_evidence.G11: The core uses selected audio and compact models; large-model training is optional.
gate_evidence.G12: Rights for the actual Sinhala fake audio and any generated derivatives remain unresolved.
gate_evidence.G13: Standard methods may suffice; waiting may not help; compression may damage early detection.

ratings.confidence_and_reason: Low: A close streaming study already exists; the added value of learning when to wait is unverified.
Low: Suitable reusable Sinhala human and generated speech has not been secured.
Low-medium: A bounded study is plausible once data and the first baseline work.
Medium: The plan trains adaptation, a waiting policy and a compact model.
Medium-low: Comparisons are defined, but suitable Sinhala test data and phone timings are missing.
Medium: Each member can test a separate idea against the same unchanged starting model.
Medium: Quick, reliable speech checks matter; protection during actual calls remains untested.
Medium-low: Small selected datasets and compact models should fit; resource use is not measured.
Medium: Existing audio can be replayed in small chunks without access to private calls.

scope: Controlled single-speaker human/generated clips replayed as prefixes; no partial-edit localisation or real-call protection claim.
